crossRefs.note: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,
He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day…
He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

translations.web: “Speak, you who ride on white donkeys, you who sit on rich carpets, and you who walk by the way.
translations.bsb: You who ride white donkeys, who sit on saddle blankets, and you who travel the road, ponder
translations.kjv: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
translations.asv: Tell of it, ye that ride on white asses, Ye that sit on rich carpets, And ye that walk by the way.
